ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the sources of funding and the individuals or organizations involved.
questions: What are the primary sources of funding for child care programs in Minnesota?
How are these funds being allocated and monitored?
ideas.insight: This investigation could reveal a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in Minnesota, and may lead to further inquiries into the state's handling of federal funds.
